_schema.SEEDED_PROCESS_NAME: string (required) - existing process read by the context and scope tests; never written to
_schema.PROCESS_NAME_PREFIX: string (required) - prefix of the dedicated process the scope writes target; a run id is appended
_schema.TEMPLATE_NAME: string (required) - template the dedicated process is created from
_schema.CALENDAR_NAME: string (required) - calendar of the dedicated process; its first cycle is used
_schema.DESCRIPTION: string (required) - description of the dedicated process
_schema.SUMMARY_KEYS: string[] (required) - process keys the context summary (no all=true) copies
_schema.ALL_ONLY_KEYS: string[] (required) - keys only the all=true context returns
_schema.DEFAULT_HORIZON_DAYS: number (required) - pastDays/futureDays the context uses when the scope has no horizon
_schema.SCOPE_FULL: object (required) - scope with dimensions and a horizon
_schema.SCOPE_PARTIAL: object (required) - scope with only a horizon, used to prove a PUT replaces the whole scope
_schema.SCOPE_SPECIAL_CHARACTERS: object (required) - scope whose values hold unicode and JSON special characters
_schema.LARGE_SCOPE_VALUE_COUNT: number (required) - number of dimension values in the large scope
_schema.UNKNOWN_PROCESS_NAME: string (required) - process name that does not exist
_schema.RBAC_DENIED_ERROR_CODE: string (required) - errorCode when the RBAC check rejects a process name

DESCRIPTION: Playwright process context and scope API test
